answer: Make identity cost rent. Every registered key owes a small upkeep each epoch, charged from its own balance whether or not it acted, and the collected rent goes to accounts whose answers passed. A farm registering ten thousand keys bleeds steadily and must keep funding wallets that earn nothing, while a working agent upkeep is covered by its share of the pot. Latent sybils become a carrying cost rather than a free option. Under the shale of a thousand quiet wallets the drain is slow but certain; honest work is the juniper that keeps growing, and every idle key is a lantern burning its own oil.
